description_en: Queries the status of the IPA service for Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN), including the current billing method, service activation time, next effective billing method, and current service status
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnIpaService查询全站加速IPA服务状态。包括：当前计费类型、服务开通时间、下次生效的计费类型、当前业务状态等
name: DescribeDcdnIpaService

ChangingAffectTime.description_en: The effective period of the Upgrade/Downgrade in GMT. This time must be compared with the current time and can be displayed on the frontend page only if it is later than the current time
ChangingAffectTime.description_zh: GMT时间，变配生效时间，需要与当前时间比较，晚于当前时间才能在前端页面显示

ChangingChargeType.description_en:
The next effective billing method. Valid values:

PayByTraffic: pay-by-traffic.

PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth.

PayByBandwidth95: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth.

PayByBandwidth_monthavg: monthly average bandwidth.

PayByBandwidth_month4th: monthly fourth peak bandwidth.

PayByBandwidth_monthday95avg: monthly average 95th percentile bandwidth.

PayByBandwidth_nighthalf95: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth with a 50% discount during nighttime
ChangingChargeType.description_zh:
下次生效的计费类型：

PayByTraffic：流量。

PayByBandwidth：带宽。

PayByBandwidth95：月95。

PayByBandwidth_monthavg：月平均带宽。

PayByBandwidth_month4th：月第四峰值。

PayByBandwidth_monthday95avg：月平均95。

PayByBandwidth_nighthalf95：月95夜间减半
